data.name: Soundscape XR: 2024
data.detailed_description:
The Soundscape journey began in 2014 with the creation of hyper-immersive virtual spaces to enjoy the music that moves you; in VR and on PC.

A decade later, we're opening the doors to a freeform, cutting-edge hybrid reality, powered by the latest technologies like UE5 and Lumen.  

Soundscape is about exploring new connections within music & visual arts. We're in the teleportation business empowering individuals with tools to connect and flow from anywhere.

The collective of artists behind the project have made the incredible choice of offering Soundscape as a gift.  Experience the magic from their fingertips to your mind.

  • Take flight and explore worlds brought to life by music, Sonic AI powers a unique experience every time.

  • Customize your Soundskin avatar and dance into another dimension to meet up with friends and fans in an artistic musical metaverse experience.

  • Bring the music you love, or get lost in sound within audiovisual experiments and collaborations with artists like Deadmau5, Goose, Slash, FISHER, and Chris Lake.

  •  Crossplay between PC & VR, both unique experiences working together in harmony to enhance your own.  Soundscape XR: 2024 supports all major legacy HMDs and motion controllers from 2014-2024. 

  • Try new experimental gamepad controls that let you VJ in whole new way from the couch.

For ten years, our collective of artists have been putting their love into building the purest virtual destination for the enjoyment of music with no ads, no data tracking, no microtransactions, no DRM, and no corporate BS. Its our honor and privilege to share with you our art and creations. It's taken a lot to build this into something that we've dreamed about, and we're so grateful for your support.

Join us on our journey to an advanced audiovisual future.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows
  • Processor: i5 3570k or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 or equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 14 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR, OpenXR, Index/Quest/Vive/Oculus Rift S, motion controllers required
  • Additional Notes: Basic requirements for PC play only
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows
  • Processor: Ryzen 3600x or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 4070 or equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 14 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR, OpenXR, Index/Quest/Vive/Oculus Rift S, motion controllers required
  • Additional Notes: How Soundscape is meant to be experienced. PC & VR play across all Soundscapes
